definitions.explanation: To cook food by submerging it in hot oil. Written with the kanji {揚|あ} to distinguish from other verbs read あげる.

examples.japanese: {鶏肉|とりにく}をカラッと{揚|あ}げる。
examples.english: I deep-fry the chicken until crispy.

examples.japanese: {天|てん}ぷらは{高温|こうおん}の{油|あぶら}で{揚|あ}げるのがコツだ。
examples.english: The trick to tempura is frying it in high-temperature oil.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}が{揚|あ}げたコロッケは{外|そと}はサクサク、{中|なか}はふわふわだ。
examples.english: The croquettes my mother deep-fried are crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside.

notes:
USAGE:
This kanji ({揚|あ}げる) specifically indicates deep-frying. Other あげる verbs use different kanji: {上|あ}げる (to raise), {挙|あ}げる (to cite), {掲|あ}げる (to display). The intransitive counterpart is {揚|あ}がる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {油|あぶら}で{揚|あ}げる (to fry in oil)
- カラッと{揚|あ}げる (to fry until crispy)
- {素揚|すあ}げ (deep-frying without batter)
